tasks.label: Git: Commit & Push
tasks.command: git add -A && git commit -m '${input:commitMessage}' && git push

windows.command: $git = if (Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { 'git' } else { 'C:/Program Files/Git/cmd/git.exe' }; & $git add -A; & $git commit -m '${input:commitMessage}'; & $git push
$git = if (Get-Command git -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { 'git' } else { 'C:/Program Files/Git/cmd/git.exe' }; & $git pull
